# TTCalc

> Free TikTok Shop seller tools — fee calculator, profit calculator, platform comparison, and AI product photos. Independent; optional Google sign-in; analytics and ads are disclosed in the privacy policy.

## Tools

- [TikTok Shop Fee Calculator](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-fee-calculator/): Calculate the full TikTok Shop fee stack including the 6% referral fee, FBT fulfillment, creator commissions, and refund administration.
- [TikTok Shop Profit Calculator](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-profit-calculator/): Model net profit per unit after TikTok fees, COGS, shipping, ad spend, creator commissions, and returns.
- [TikTok Shop ROAS Calculator](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-roas-calculator/): Break-even ROAS plus net profit per unit and per month after TikTok fees, COGS, creator commissions, and ad spend.
- [TikTok Shop FBT Calculator](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-fbt-calculator/): Compute FBT chargeable weight under the official rule (actual weight at or under 2 lb and 332 cu in; otherwise the greater of actual and dimensional weight, LxWxH/166), find your fulfillment tier, and compare FBT with self-ship and 3PL quotes.
- [TikTok Shop Storage Fee Calculator](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-fbt-storage-calculator/): Cost of holding FBT inventory by box size, unit count and days held, using the official per-cubic-foot daily rate tiers (first 60 days free; $0.03 to $0.27 per cu ft per day by age).
- [TikTok vs Amazon FBA](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-vs-amazon/): Side-by-side comparison of TikTok Shop and Amazon FBA fees and profit at the same price point.
- [TikTok Shop Product Photo Generator](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-product-photo/): Generate marketplace-ready product photos from a description, with scene and aspect-ratio presets.
- [Embed a calculator](https://ttcalc.shop/embed/): Copy an iframe snippet to place any of the five calculators on your own blog, course or seller resource. Free, no attribution required.

## Rate data

- [TikTok Shop Fee Rate Updates](https://ttcalc.shop/rate-updates/): Dated log of every 2026 TikTok Shop fee change we track — referral rate, FBT rate card, refund admin fee — each entry with its effective date, the date we verified it, and a link to the official source. Two sub-sections carry the evidence: the per-claim verdict table (https://ttcalc.shop/rate-updates/#claims) and the sources-by-claim table (https://ttcalc.shop/rate-updates/#sources), which lists the individual sources behind each figure with the date we read each one.

## Guides

- [TikTok Shop Fees on a $20 Product](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-fee-calculator-20-dollar-product-2026/): A $19.99 product carries $5.72 of platform fees, 28.6% of the sale price, because the referral fee scales with price and FBT does not. Line-by-line worked example.
- [FBT Fee Per Unit 2026](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-fbt-fee-per-unit-2026/): Every FBT weight tier we track, from $4.28 to $12.67 per unit (single items up to 16 lb), why the tier matters more than the price, and how multi-item orders price per order instead of per unit.
- [Break-Even ROAS Formula](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-break-even-roas-formula-2026/): Break-even ROAS = revenue (item price + any buyer-paid shipping) ÷ profit before ad spend. Worked on a $29.99 product, with creator-commission and return sensitivity up to 4.50×.
- [TikTok Shop Fees vs Shopify](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-fees-vs-shopify-2026/): Commission vs subscription plus payment processing. Cost per unit at $15, $30 and $100, and where each channel wins.
- [Best TikTok Shop Product Research Tools 2026](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/best-tiktok-shop-product-research-tools-2026/): What the free tier covers, when a paid research tool pays for itself, and the per-unit cost of a subscription at different volumes.
- [FastMoss vs Kalodata 2026](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/fastmoss-vs-kalodata-2026/): Published pricing, history windows and daily quotas compared, plus which tool suits creator outreach vs long-run category history.
- [TikTok Shop Payout Methods 2026](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-payout-methods-payoneer-vs-wise-2026/): Payoneer vs Wise vs bank transfer, including the exchange-rate spread neither provider publishes and the break-even size for fixed vs percentage fees.
- [TikTok Shop Fees in 2026: A Complete Breakdown](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-fees-2026/): Every fee TikTok charges sellers in 2026 — referral, FBT fulfillment, creator commissions, refund administration.
- [Free AI Product Photos for TikTok Shop 2026](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/free-ai-product-photos-2026/): A repeatable workflow for turning one truthful product photo into marketplace-ready scene variations, with prompt, ratio, and listing checks.
- [TikTok Shop Profit Killers: 5 Hidden Mistakes](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-profit-killers-2026/): Five mistakes that silently destroy TikTok Shop margins.
- [GMV Max on TikTok Shop 2026](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-gmv-max-2026/): Budget rules (10x AOV), ROAS benchmarks (2.5x), scaling strategy for TikTok's automated ad system.
- [TikTok Shop Affiliate Program 2026](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-affiliate-program-2026/): Open vs Target plans, commission rates (official range 1-80%; third-party US average ~13%), clawback mechanics.
- [How to Set TikTok Shop Creator Commission](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-how-to-set-creator-commission-2026/): Reverse-solve the highest affordable rate from your cost stack and target margin; blended rate and sample amortization.
- [FBT Dimensional Weight: the 2 lb / 332 cu in Rule](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-fbt-dimensional-weight-2026/): The official chargeable-weight rule with worked examples, the 166 divisor (not 139), size limits, and packaging moves that drop a tier.
- [8 TikTok Shop Fee Myths, Checked Against TikTok's Own Pages](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-fee-myths-2026/): Eight widely repeated fee claims tested against TikTok's own documents - no 2.9% + $0.30 transaction fee in the policy, no 30-day term on the 3% rate, the 166 divisor, 60-day free storage.
- [Dead Stock: When Discounting Beats Waiting](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-fbt-dead-stock-2026/): FBT storage priced per cubic foot per day across eight age tiers; a 400-unit batch worked out tier by tier and the day waiting costs more than discounting.
- [FBT Restock Timing: How Much to Send, and How Often](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-fbt-restock-timing-2026/): the 60-day free window is per unit; sizing a batch to 60 days of sales takes storage to zero, and worked examples for a fast seller and a slow one.
- [TikTok Shop Return Rates Guide](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-return-rates-cost-2026/): Return rates by category and the true cost of returns, including refund admin and June 2026 FBT per-item handling fees.

- [TikTok Shop vs Amazon FBA 2026](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-vs-amazon-fba-2026/): Complete fee and profit comparison with real $30 product examples.
- [TikTok Shop SEO Guide](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-seo-guide-2026/): Product listing optimization for TikTok Shop search in 2026.
- [TikTok Shop Live Shopping Strategy 2026](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-live-shopping-strategy-2026/): How to plan broadcasts, structure deals, choose products, and convert viewers into buyers.
- [TikTok Shop Account Health Rating 2026](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-account-health-rating-2026/): How the Account Health Rating works, what triggers violations, and how to maintain good standing.
- [TikTok Shop Content Strategy 2026](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-content-strategy-2026/): The 3-second rule, content types that convert, posting volume, and tying short-video views to real profit.

- [TikTok Shop First Sale Playbook 2026](https://ttcalc.shop/blog/tiktok-shop-first-sale-playbook-2026/): Registration docs, first-product selection, real 2026 fee math, listing and content that converts, and a first-30-days checklist for new sellers.

## 中文说明

> 面向中文使用者与中文检索的等价入口。所有计算器与正文均支持中文（在页面右下角切换），
> 数值口径与英文版完全一致。以下描述对应的正文已全部中文化。

### 工具

- [TikTok Shop 费用计算器](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-fee-calculator/)：算清完整费用栈 —— 6% 推荐费、FBT 履约、达人佣金、退款管理费。
- [TikTok Shop 利润计算器](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-profit-calculator/)：在费用、商品成本、运费、广告、达人佣金与退货之后，测算每件净利。
- [TikTok Shop ROAS 计算器](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-roas-calculator/)：算盈亏平衡 ROAS，以及每件与每月净利。
- [TikTok Shop FBT 计算器](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-fbt-calculator/)：按官方规则算 FBT 计费重（实重不超过 2 lb 且 332 立方英寸，否则取实重与体积重 LxWxH/166 中的较大者），确定履约档位，并与自发货、3PL 对比。
- [TikTok Shop 仓储费计算器](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-fbt-storage-calculator/)：按箱规、件数与天数算仓储费，用官方每立方英尺每日费率档（前 60 天免费；$0.03 到 $0.27 每立方英尺每天）。
- [TikTok 与 Amazon FBA 对比](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-vs-amazon/)：同一定价下并排比较两个渠道的费用与利润。
- [TikTok Shop 商品图生成器](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-product-photo/)：从描述生成可直接上架的商品图，附带场景与比例预设。
- [嵌入计算器](https://ttcalc.shop/embed/)：复制一段 iframe 代码，把计算器放到你自己的博客、课程或卖家资源里。免费，无需署名。

### 费率数据

- [TikTok Shop 费率更新日志](https://ttcalc.shop/rate-updates/)：按日期记录 2026 年每一项费用变化 —— 推荐费率、FBT 费率卡、退款管理费 —— 每条都带生效日期、核实日期与官方来源链接。证据分两节：[逐条结论表](https://ttcalc.shop/rate-updates/#claims)与[逐条来源表](https://ttcalc.shop/rate-updates/#sources)。

### 常见问题

- [为什么我的利润和 Seller Center 后台对不上？](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-profit-calculator/)：后台只显示扣除 6% 佣金后的总额，不会单独拆出 FBT 履约、跨境费用与达人佣金。加回去后实际到手通常低 10-15%。
- [TikTok 只收 6% 吗？](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-fee-calculator/)：不是。官方政策只有一项佣金（6%，部分类目 5%），此外还有 FBT 履约（$4.28-$12.67/件）、跨境费用（约 1%）与达人佣金（自定 1-80%）。
- [达人佣金是在 TikTok 费用之外另付吗？](https://ttcalc.shop/tools/tiktok-creator-commission-calculator/)：是，与推荐费独立计算。官方区间 1-80%，第三方统计美国均值约 13%，但 TikTok 未公布官方均值。
